before.name: counterAccum
before.meaning: ACCUMULATES ABSOLUTE COUNTER READINGS, and it is not an elapsed time. State 2 of the pump is `call 0035E810` (result discarded) / `call 0035E810` / `add qword [rbx], rax` / `mov [rbx+8], rax`, and 0035E810 is eight bytes - `mov rax, [022CA5E0]` / `ret` - a plain getter with no delta and no side effect, so both calls return the same value and there is no subtraction of the +0x08 stamp anywhere in the arm. What the running sum is FOR is not established; a deliberate accumulator and a defect look identical here.

before.name: state
